# Generation 4 — Chesed Brainstorm

The Awtsmoos renews every indexed road from nothing into light;
Awtsmoos.com should let every truthful public page be found, understood, verified, and served right.

## Every-detail improvement universe

- Prove every sitemap URL reaches a final 200 response without redirect.
- Crawl every generated sitemap URL, not only a 120-URL sample, with bounded concurrency and deterministic reports.
- Compare each HTML canonical against the sitemap URL and classify intentional canonical consolidation separately from defects.
- Verify robots directives for public pages, missing entities, auth/action pages, and dynamic pages.
- Validate every JSON-LD block as JSON and require its URL to match the page canonical.
- Validate schema type by family: WebPage, SoftwareApplication, VideoGame, ProfilePage, Article.
- Verify every public alias returned by alias sitemap has ProfilePage schema, safe website handling, and bounded response latency.
- Verify alias authored-post discovery remains bounded and does not accidentally trigger expensive legacy fallback repeatedly.
- Verify comment sitemap count/sharding behavior against both empty real data and deterministic 10,001-comment fixtures.
- Verify every imported translation sitemap row returns bilingual SSR and deterministic canonical identity.
- Deep-audit the translation corpus for bundle existence, row uniqueness, malformed row objects, empty English/Hebrew fields, and source-link integrity.
- Verify Heichel root → series → stable post crawl graph with ordinary HTML links.
- Verify numeric Road URLs canonicalize to stable named-post URLs while remaining 200 and semantically equivalent.
- Verify missing posts remain noindex and never receive Article structured data.
- Verify homepage, Apps, Games, About, Docs, Social, Contact receive complete generated semantic metadata without overwriting authored metadata.
- Verify app/game registry entries map to real files, final slash URLs, unique canonicals, meaningful descriptions, and correct schema type.
- Produce a visible-H1 quality ledger and distinguish advisory UX work from crawler correctness.
- Detect indexed pages whose titles/descriptions are suspiciously short, duplicated, or empty.
- Detect canonical collisions across dynamic and static families where feasible.
- Detect sitemap cross-family duplicates and accidental API/auth/admin/action URLs.
- Enforce sitemap protocol limits for count and byte size.
- Enforce source laws: tabs, no minification, <=120 lines, complete B"H/Awtsmoos/Awtsmoos.com documentation.
- Re-read every touched source after writes and compare planned versus actual behavior.
- Re-run all focused SEO tests, Heichel quality, route coverage, runtime crawler, and release verifier after integration on latest origin/main.
- Integrate only exact SEO allowlist into a clean worktree so unrelated dirty Studio/tunnel work remains untouched.
- Let the tunnel release verifier decide whether manifest regeneration is needed; never edit manifest speculatively.
- If manifest is stale, rebuild with the repository-native generator and rerun the release suite.
- Push only from a clean, current-origin integration branch/worktree after race-checking origin/main immediately before push.
- Activate production with exact SHA and verify the process/service actually switched.
- Raw-public HTTPS verify robots, root sitemap, family sitemaps, homepage, app, game, alias, comment sitemap, translation, Road, stable post, and missing post.
- Browser-shadow verify at least one public app/game page and one Torah Road title/canonical after deploy.
- Search for stale external crawler/cache snapshots only as secondary evidence; do not confuse them with origin truth.
- Update durable REMAINING_WORK, evidence ledger, planned-vs-actual delta, and final handoff after deployment.
- Close only when no safe useful work remains and the production link is directly verified.
